visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a modern, brightly lit living room, a young man with short black hair wearing a white T-shirt kneels on a grey floor next to a tan Shiba Inu dog. He holds a green roll of poop bags, gesturing toward the dog who sits calmly wearing a thin gold chain. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot where the man holds up a colorful dog harness featuring red, yellow, and green straps. Behind them is a light-colored wooden cabinet topped with a large Godzilla figure and some books. (3) The man leans in to pet the dog's cheek with a warm smile as several animated red heart icons float around them. The dog remains neutral, sitting on the floor in front of the cabinet. (4) A quick transition shows the man holding a transparent bag of chicken jerky treats labeled in Chinese. He points at the bag while the dog looks directly at the camera with an attentive expression. (5) The man presents a white ceramic bowl filled with dry dog food, tilting it toward the camera lens. The dog remains seated next to him, watching the bowl while the background shows a wooden door and wall. (6) In a bedroom setting, the man makes a heart shape with his hands near his chest while looking affectionately at the dog. The dog sits upright on the floor, looking toward the camera without reciprocating the man's gaze. (7) The man points toward a white, plush dog bed on the floor in front of a shelf filled with toys and figures. The dog is positioned near the bed, and the lighting is soft and indoor-focused. (8) The man holds up a light blue, rectangular pee pad, shaking it slightly to show its texture. The dog is lying down or sitting nearby, observing the man's actions against a neutral-colored wall background. (9) The man holds a white piece of paper with text on it; the dog suddenly becomes aggressive, barking loudly and lunging toward the paper. The man flinches back, and red anger icons appear over the dog's head.
